unit: hard sets per muscle per week

sources.citation: Israetel M. / Renaissance Periodization. Training Volume Landmarks for Muscle Growth (MV, MEV, MAV, MRV chart).
sources.note: Values marked rp_chart were read from a transcription of the RP chart (biceps, back, abs, calves, chest).

sources.citation: Israetel M., Hoffmann J., Smith C.W. Scientific Principles of Hypertrophy Training (Renaissance Periodization), per-muscle landmark summaries.
sources.note: Values marked rp_summary come from secondary summaries of the RP guide (triceps, quads, hamstrings, side delts, traps). MV values for these are from the RP guide and were not independently re-verified.

sources.citation: Schoenfeld BJ, Ogborn D, Krieger JW. Dose-response relationship between weekly resistance training volume and increases in muscle mass: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Sports Sci 2017;35(11):1073-1082.
sources.note: Corroborates MEV: graded dose-response with 10+ weekly direct sets per muscle producing greater hypertrophy than fewer than 5.

lats.note: RP lists one back group; applied to lats.

front_delts.note: RP states pressing covers front delts; value not re-verified online.

rear_delts.note: RP groups rear delts with shoulders; value not re-verified online.

core.note: RP abs group; MAV depends on current ab volume.
